Diego (Eng Manager): Heads up 1384 Our Q3 launch sprint overlaps with the national holiday on June 18. A few folks want PTO that day. Any blackout or mandatory coverage policy?
Maya (People Ops): Short answer: we don't do blanket PTO denials for public holidays. We do require coverage plans for critical oncall/sprint days.
Nina (IC): I'm scheduled for oncall rotation that week. If I take June 18 off, do I forfeit the oncall pay or can we swap?
Raj (Oncall Lead): We can swap rotations. Preference: swap within team first, then cross-team. If no swap found, team lead submits a coverage exception and People Ops will assign a backup.
Diego (Eng Manager): Ok. Also one PM asked if we can allow carryover for a lost holiday day due to required coverage (e.g., they work the holiday). Is that possible?
Lina (People Ops Lead): If someone works a company-recognized holiday due to business need, they can request compensatory time (comp-day) or extra PTO accrual in rare cases. Manager must submit a Holiday Comp Request form within 14 days. Payroll will review for eligibility.
Sophie (Payroll): Confirming: submit via the payroll portal (link in handbook). If approved, comp-day is added to the employee's balance within next payroll cycle. Note: comp cannot be converted to cash unless under specific local law exceptions.
Nina (IC): What's the timeline for approvals? We have a bunch of last-minute PTO asks.
Maya (People Ops): For urgent coverage requests: managers should try swaps; if not possible, escalate to People Ops with `coverage-needed` tag. We'll triage within 48h.
Diego (Eng Manager): Can we set a temporary soft-blackout for core roles (oncall owners) so people get a heads-up before booking?
Lina (People Ops Lead): We can ask HRbot to surface a soft warning when booking time-off that intersects with critical shift dates. It's not a denial, just a tooltip and a prompt to coordinate with your manager.
HRbot: Suggested action [0m[32m[0m — add `critical-shift` warning on time-off requests that overlap dates flagged by teams. Enable?
Diego (Eng Manager): Yes please enable for June 15-20 for our team.
Maya (People Ops): Enabled for Diego's team window June 15-20. HRbot will add: "This date overlaps a flagged critical shift. Coordinate with your manager before finalizing."
Sophie (Payroll): Quick payroll note: if comp-day is granted and added to balance, it will appear as `Comp-Hol` in the next pay export. Managers, please cc payroll@redwood for bulk exceptions.
Nina (IC): Thanks all. If I swap with Priyanka, do I need to file anything?
Raj (Oncall Lead): Just log the swap in the oncall rota doc and cc me. People Ops will only need to see it if a backup assignment is required.
Diego (Eng Manager): I'll talk to the team and post our coverage plan here by EOD.
Maya (People Ops): Great. Closing guidance summary: 1) No auto-deny for holiday PTO; 2) swap within team first; 3) tag `coverage-needed` if no swap; 4) submit Holiday Comp Request within 14 days if someone works the holiday; 5) HRbot soft-warning enabled for June 15-20. Link to handbook section: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PeopleOps/pages/Holiday+Coverage+Policy
Nina (IC): :thumbsup:
